title: Chicken Tacos
instructions: Season chicken with cumin, chili powder, salt, and pepper. Cook in a skillet over medium-high heat for 6-7 minutes per side until cooked through. Slice and serve in warmed tortillas with toppings.

title: Vegetable Stir Fry
instructions: Heat oil in a wok over high heat. Add garlic and ginger, cook 30 seconds. Add vegetables and stir fry for 5-7 minutes. Add soy sauce and sesame oil, toss to combine. Serve over rice.
